title: SUPER Module for Detail-Sensitive and Cost-Efficient U-Net Variant Decoders
mechanism: Wavelet-domain decoder block: DWT of decoder features, a learned per-channel bounded suppression (tanh(CBAM) x learnable scale) subtracted from all subbands, and an inverse DWT that replaces spatial upsample + refine.
adaptation: Replace the U-Net++ upsample + conv refine at the 256 and 512 px decoder levels with Haar IDWT + suppression. Implement Haar as fixed 2x2 convs; keep the ResNet-34 encoder and the PF schedule; 1-channel input unchanged.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + SUPER at decoder levels 0 and 1, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2, components >= 20 px found. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012 and relF1@2 < +0.01.
evidence: R: CrackVision12K with a FACS-Net baseline. IoU on 0 to 2 px cracks 0.356 -> 0.451, 2 to 4 px 0.398 -> 0.415, average 0.629 -> 0.646; CTS also up.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF section 5 (2x resolution n.d. is a different mechanism). Also listed by D09.
